description:

featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amcha Ghar, home for the girls.
From Bhayandar West it is about 12 Km., by share a Rick it taked around half an hour to reach Uttan Naka a fare of INR 40/-. If you take a Rick exclusively for you then it will cost you INR 200/-. From there walkable distance to reach Amch Ghar.
The Home is situated in a Housing Colony - Deep Sagar CHS on the third floor.
At the moment the home is under maintenance and repairs.
Children are residing at the School Hall.
An English Medium High School, Government recognised, also by the same name is established, it has its Bus service for the local kids.
The Girls Home gas 28 girl children residing, age group from nursery to FYJC.
All are free sustaining on donations.
Care is taken by female staff for the day time and in the night another staff stays with the children.
They are provided stay, academic and  Food.
Children are happy with their stay and enjoy themselves, checked with locals residing in and around, the reply was positive and pleasing.
This, the donation used in the right manner.
Hope the above report is appropriate and convincing.
You may donate if you feel right.
If any one feels right about the above report and wants to donate for the betterment of the society, request you to donate and assured your donation will be used in the right cause, helping your, deserving girls. The future of tomorrow.
Have attached cancelled cheque, if you want to donate.
What you earn from the Society, it is our duty, if possible to repay back a small token to the Society.
My earnest request to all, please donate atleast 1% of your earnings for the betterment of the society.
The money donated to Amcha Ghar is definitely going in the right hands  and for upbringing ness.
My humble and earnest earnest request.

name: Sahas Charitable Trust
description:
Sahas Charitable Trust ( SCT) is a charitable institution registered with income tax act under 12AA/12AB and NITI Aayog , SCT is an institution benefitting to various needy and underprivileged children and families through various projects such as Medical aid, education and financial support , old age support , income generation activities, food and nutrition.

SCT works with the society to transform the lives. Initially, worked with street kids and underprivileged sections to lay specific emphasis on child education and mother nutrition so they can live better tomorrow with dignity and respect in society. SCT seeks to empower and cultivate better national.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm very thankful to my teacher that she gave me an activity to work 60 hrs in ngo and spread the good or any valuable skills of mine to other students and I choose this ngo, I volunteered for a month there. I was teaching 6 std students, and literally most of the students are very sharp and intelligent in studies and in all extra curricular activities which have been done there.
